name: Winstar Capital Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；公告主要涉及季度业绩、股东大会及续延关联交易授权。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长33.1%，净利润同比增长3.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments in its announcements; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, general meetings, and renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue increased 33.1% year-on-year and net profit increased 3.4% year-on-year.
